pages.title: Sea Survivor
pages.creator: Tech Nova Games
pages.description: Sea Survivor places your ship in an overhead battle against waves of enemy vessels. Steer through the sea, fire the cannons and gather loot from the fighting. Improve the ship as you work to survive the next group of attackers.

pages.title: Smash Defense
pages.creator: Mao Games
pages.description: Smash Defense uses a baseball bat and ball against waves of flying monsters. Swing to strike enemies and develop the ball with fire, electricity or explosive effects. Upgrade abilities while traveling through environments such as oceans and volcanic landscapes.

pages.title: Blast Cubes
pages.creator: minigame
pages.description: Blast Cubes links grid puzzles with filling colored vehicles. Place cubes to complete horizontal or vertical rows and trigger blasts, releasing matching characters toward the waiting transport. Meet the loading goal while planning enough room for subsequent placements.

pages.title: Radical Rappelling
pages.creator: Yes2Games
pages.description: Radical Rappelling follows Rip and Roxy descending steep mountains. Tap to jump between cliff faces and avoid obstacles, using launch pads and other effects to continue the descent. Gather coins while attempting tricks along the route.

pages.title: Barbee Black Friday Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Barbee Black Friday Fashion takes Barbee shopping for a new wardrobe. Choose winter clothes, sweaters, boots and accessories from the available fashion pieces, combining them into a complete look for her day at the mall.

pages.title: Mega Jump
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Mega Jump sends a character upward across platforms with coins and hazards. Steer toward the next landing, collect useful boosts and keep clear of obstacles. Climb higher without falling to improve the score earned on the ascent.

pages.title: Help Me: Tricky Brain Puzzles
pages.creator: TapNation
pages.description: Help Me: Tricky Brain Puzzles presents unusual situations that need a solution. Touch, swipe and drag objects to investigate clues, then make choices that resolve the scene. Each level introduces another riddle or decision to work out.

pages.title: Fun Sorting Through The Shelves
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Fun Sorting Through The Shelves asks you to organize matching objects on shelves. Drag three identical items onto the same shelf to merge the group and free space. Clear the required arrangements while collecting decorations for your virtual room.

pages.title: Auto Ninja
pages.creator: Omni Play
pages.description: Auto Ninja puts a ninja through forty-one trap-filled chambers. Start the run, time jumps and double jumps, then hold in the air to glide past hazards. Find all three coins in a room to work toward additional ninja skins.

pages.title: Stickman Sort
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Stickman Sort challenges you to group stick figures according to their color or design. Select a character and move it into a suitable slot, bringing at least three matching figures together to clear them. Study the differences when a level introduces trickier designs.

pages.title: Family Idle Farm: Build & Harvest
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Family Idle Farm: Build & Harvest combines growing crops and raising animals with developing a farm. Collect the produced resources, process goods and improve buildings or fields. Automatic harvesting keeps production moving while you plan the next expansion.

pages.title: Brainrot Clicker
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Brainrot Clicker turns taps into points for unlocking meme characters. Keep clicking or use the supported keys to increase the total, building up the collection as it develops. A two-player mode gives each participant separate scoring controls.

pages.title: SHOT CAN WILD
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: SHOT CAN WILD asks you to keep a can airborne by shooting it. Tap at the right moment to hit the central target and make a COOL SHOT, chaining accurate hits to restore ammunition before the supply runs out.

pages.title: Clap Clap Nightmare
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Clap Clap Nightmare casts you as a house sitter investigating strange events inside an ordinary-looking home. Move through the rooms and use the action control to interact, exploring the unsettling occurrences that develop during the short horror story.

pages.title: Choo Choo Spider Monster Train
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: Choo Choo Spider Monster Train puts a small armed train between you and a monstrous spider-train. Use the island map to navigate, fight threats with the mounted weapon and improve the train's speed and armor as the survival journey continues.

pages.title: Royal puzzle Burst
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: Royal puzzle Burst connects colored-block clearing with defending against attacking blobs. Select matching-colored blocks to burst them and remove threats, examining the available groups as you work through each stage's combination of puzzle choices and enemies.

pages.title: Survival Sword Battle
pages.creator: Briuor
pages.description: Survival Sword Battle sends a swordsman into a free-for-all where one hit ends the attempt. Guide the character, attack opponents and use a speed boost to reposition. Unlock character evolutions that improve movement as you pursue a longer survival score.

pages.title: Special Holiday Solitaire
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Special Holiday Solitaire places card-clearing puzzles in a festive setting. Work through the exposed cards, turn to the draw pile when needed, and use wild cards or boosters to help clear difficult layouts and advance through the levels.

pages.title: Conduct This
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Conduct This asks you to clear obstacles from railway tracks before a train passes. Move the pieces that block the route and get the train safely through the level. Successful runs earn coins that unlock different train appearances.

pages.title: Cuddle Monster Fusion
pages.creator: Shanghai ZINENG Technology Co., LTD
pages.description: Cuddle Monster Fusion lets you drop matching monsters together to evolve them into new creatures. Aim each release and consider where it will land, building further combinations without allowing the growing collection to overflow its play area.

pages.title: Dop Puzzle Erase Master
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Dop Puzzle Erase Master gives you illustrated situations with a hidden solution. Decide which part of the picture should be erased and remove it to reveal the answer, trying to identify the detail that resolves each scene's puzzle.

pages.title: Cyber Highway Escape
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Cyber Highway Escape takes a motorcycle through neon-lit futuristic streets. Steer around obstacles and follow the winding road, managing the bike's route at speed. Use the wheelie control as you work through the nighttime riding challenge.

pages.title: Spot Differs
pages.creator: Ringier Axel Springer Polska
pages.description: Spot Differs asks you to find changes between paired pictures within a time limit. Compare their objects and details, selecting at least five differences in each level. Complete the required discoveries before the clock expires to continue to another scene.

pages.title: Animals Blocks
pages.creator: Filgame
pages.description: Animals Blocks gives you animal-shaped pieces to fit into a puzzle board. Position each block so its shape fills the available cells, planning around the gaps left by earlier placements. Work through layouts with increasing difficulty and use help when needed.

pages.title: Marbles Sorting
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Marbles Sorting asks you to separate mixed marbles into tubes containing only one kind. Transfer the pieces between containers and plan around the available room, keeping enough space to finish organizing the marbles that remain unsorted.

pages.title: Survivor In Rainbow Monster
pages.creator: Bin Studio
pages.description: Survivor In Rainbow Monster follows a kidnapped visitor inside Spooky Park. Complete the changing nightly tasks, including finding blocks, repairing machinery and lighting rooms. Work through the assignments while trying to survive the monsters surrounding the amusement park.

pages.title: Draw Car Fight
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Draw Car Fight lets you build fighting equipment for a stickman's vehicle by drawing parts. Shape additions that help its wheels smash the red opponent's car, then use the forward and reverse controls to carry out your plan during the battle.

pages.title: Stickmen Crowd Fight
pages.creator: Drmop Games
pages.description: Stickmen Crowd Fight sends a growing group of fighters through a city course. Choose gates that increase the crowd, avoid traffic and obstacles, then clash with opposing groups. Build enough strength to break towers and take on the bosses ahead.

pages.title: TicToc Dance
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: TicToc Dance prepares two friends to record a short dance video. Choose makeup, hairstyles and outfits for the shoot, coordinating the looks before their performance. Watch the finished dance once the styling preparations are complete.

pages.title: Hungry Box - Eat before time runs out
pages.creator: jetlabgames
pages.description: Hungry Box - Eat before time runs out gives a moving box ten seconds to reach food. Hold to adjust the red stick's length so the box has a route to follow. Eating resets the timer, letting you continue and work toward unlocking more characters.

pages.title: Mini Golf Club
pages.creator: Obumo Games
pages.description: Mini Golf Club offers online miniature-golf matches with public opponents or friends. Aim to complete the course efficiently while competing for a stronger result. Choose a public region or configure a private match for the group you want to play with.

pages.title: FNaF Shooter
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: FNaF Shooter traps you in a supermarket where animatronics hunt after dark. Explore with a selection of weapons, aim at the attackers and reload as the encounter continues. Keep fighting through the creatures while moving around the store to stay alive.

pages.title: Screw the Nut 3
pages.creator: Garbuz Studio
pages.description: Screw the Nut 3 turns joining a nut and bolt into an underwater physics puzzle. Interact with the scene's objects to guide the nut toward the screw, considering how each change affects its movement until the two pieces meet.

pages.title: Queen of Pop
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Queen of Pop turns falling musical notes into a rhythm challenge. Wait for each note to reach the correct moment and tap in time with the song. Three missed notes end the attempt, so keep watching the upcoming sequence.

pages.title: Pop it Knockout Royale
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Pop it Knockout Royale puts bubbles above each competitor's head in a popping race. Move with swipes and tap to burst your own bubbles, trying to clear them before the other players finish their sets.

pages.title: Imposter 3D
pages.creator: Hitgames.org
pages.description: Imposter 3D asks you to complete missions aboard a ship taken by pirates. Move through the three-dimensional surroundings, use the attack control and work toward rescuing friends. Later tasks make reclaiming the vessel increasingly difficult.

pages.title: Halloween Idle World
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Halloween Idle World lets you build a seasonal world through clicking and upgrades. Collect skulls, harvest pumpkins and unlock additional spooky items, reinvesting progress into the objects that expand the Halloween-themed setting.

pages.title: Dont Fall io
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Dont Fall io puts competitors on a platform above water. Move to keep your character on the remaining surface while other players struggle to stay up. Outlast the group and become the final participant still on the platform.

pages.title: Dreamlike Room
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Dreamlike Room provides furniture and colorful decorations for designing an imagined bedroom. Drag the items into place and compare how they fit together, creating a room that can include the unicorn theme and other details you choose.

pages.title: Celebrity Guess Bollywood
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Celebrity Guess Bollywood asks you to identify Bollywood celebrities from their pictures. Compare the faces with the possible names and choose an answer, working through recognizable performers such as Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone.

pages.title: Angry Boss
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Angry Boss turns a cartoon boss into the target of a weapon sandbox. Tap to strike the character, then buy different weapons and abilities to try. Experiment with the available attacks as you continue through the game's destruction activity.

pages.title: Car Driving Stunt Game 3d
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Car Driving Stunt Game 3d sends cars across stunt routes with elevated jumps. Collect diamonds, launch between points and use nitro when extra speed helps the approach. Unlock faster vehicles as you complete more of the driving challenges.

pages.title: Monster truck racing Legend
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Monster truck racing Legend puts you in a large truck on a driving course. Use the directional controls to keep moving along the route, taking the vehicle through its obstacles. Built-in stability keeps the truck from flipping during the run.

pages.title: Weapon Strike
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Weapon Strike challenges you to land thrown weapons on a rotating target. Watch the obstacles as they circle, choose an opening, and time each throw carefully. Collect coins and visit the weapon shop to expand your equipment.

pages.title: Offroad Monster Hill Truck
pages.creator: gamefun
pages.description: Offroad Monster Hill Truck takes a heavy truck into mountain terrain. Steer through the uneven route and manage its climb over hills, choosing careful approaches to the slopes as you try to keep the large vehicle moving under control.

pages.title: Summer Drinks Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Summer Drinks Puzzle provides six pictures of seasonal drinks with four jigsaw sizes. Choose 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces and rebuild the selected image, matching the glassware, colors and background details as the complete scene takes shape.

pages.title: Farm Animal Transport Truck Game
pages.creator: gamefun
pages.description: Farm Animal Transport Truck Game puts you in charge of moving livestock from farms toward the city. Drive the loaded transport truck carefully around other vehicles and animals, keeping the horses, cows and other passengers secure during the trip.

pages.title: Oil Tanker Transport Game simulation
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Oil Tanker Transport Game puts a large tanker onto mountain and off-road driving routes. Handle the heavy trailer through the bends and uneven terrain, keeping its movement controlled as you work through the transport simulation's road challenges.

pages.title: Soft Girl Aesthetic
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Soft Girl Aesthetic lets you explore a fashion theme with Elsa, Harley Quinn and Ariana Grande. Choose clothing and coordinate the available pieces for each character, assembling separate looks inspired by their shared soft-girl style.

pages.title: Master Thief
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Master Thief asks you to steal valuable paintings and escape the police. Approach a picture, grab it and move away from the pursuing officers, choosing a route that keeps the thief clear of capture as the levels become more demanding.

pages.title: Stock Boxes
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Stock Boxes puts a forklift into a warehouse-stacking challenge. Collect the arriving boxes and place them carefully on the growing pile. Poor positioning can make the stack fall, so each new box needs a stable landing to keep the round going.

pages.title: Tiny Blues Vs Mini Reds
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Tiny Blues Vs Mini Reds puts your blue army in defense of a strategic base. Choose units and place them where the red attackers can be stopped, considering which troops suit the incoming threats as each assault approaches.

pages.title: Winter Frozen
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Winter Frozen turns ice crystals into a matching puzzle. Arrange three or more identical pieces in a row or column to remove them, gathering the number of blocks required by each stage. Keep finding useful combinations until the target is met.

pages.title: War Robot Car Speed Fire
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: War Robot Car Speed puts an armed police car into a city threatened by robots and gangs. Drive into position and use the firing control against the machines, working through the action as you try to bring the chaotic streets under control.

pages.title: Gun Strike
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Gun Strike puts a soldier into first-person firefights with light and heavy weapons. Move through the combat area, aim and fire at threats, using jumps, crouching and acceleration to reposition. A time-dilation control adds another option during the encounters.

pages.title: Sky Rolling ball
pages.creator: GamesBly.com
pages.description: Sky Rolling ball sends a ball along elevated tracks lined with hazards. Steer left and right to follow the route, avoid moving traps, and keep away from the edges. A missed turn can send the ball off the track.

pages.title: Hidden Sea Treasure
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Hidden Sea Treasure asks you to find nine concealed treasures in each sea-themed picture. Examine the scene and select the hidden objects, working through six images to complete the search. Look closely at the smaller details around the remaining items.

pages.title: Heavy Machinery Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Heavy Machinery Jigsaw offers five construction-vehicle pictures in three puzzle sizes. Choose 25, 49 or 100 pieces and move the sections into place, comparing the machinery and background details until the original image is restored.

pages.title: Bomb The Bridge
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Bomb The Bridge turns a bridge demolition into a timing puzzle. Place the game's charges on the structure and wait for enemy troops to cross before triggering the blast. Destroy the full bridge and eliminate every troop to earn three stars.

pages.title: Super Doll Twins Birth
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Super Doll Twins Birth follows a heroine waiting for an ambulance before delivering twins. Complete her virtual preparation activities, then help with caring for the babies after their arrival. Work through the newborn routine as the family prepares to return home.

pages.title: Blocky
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Blocky asks you to fit matching block shapes onto a puzzle board. Drag the pieces into suitable positions and consider the gaps left behind, arranging the full set correctly to complete the level and open the next challenge.

pages.title: Galaxy Retro
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Galaxy Retro is a space shooter built around battles with incoming enemy ships. Move your spacecraft through their attacks, return fire, and survive successive formations. Enemy projectiles and larger opponents make positioning as important as keeping your guns on target.

pages.title: Color Bump
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Color Bump puts a rolling ball on courses filled with colored obstacles. Swipe to guide it through the available gaps and avoid the dangerous colors. Keep adjusting your route as new arrangements of obstacles appear ahead.

pages.title: Valentine Pets Coloring Book
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Valentine Pets Coloring Book offers six pet pictures with twenty-four colors to choose from. Fill the selected drawing quickly for a better score, combining shades into your own design. Save the completed picture or print it when you are finished.

pages.title: Candy Land
pages.creator: Vianim
pages.description: Candy Land is a timed puzzle about connecting matching sweets. Drag across neighboring candies of the same kind to remove a chain from the board. New pieces fill the gaps as you build your score before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Cute Ball
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Cute Ball challenges you to guide a ball through a course of traps. Watch for safe passages and keep the character clear of hazards, trying to extend the attempt and improve the score as the adventure continues.

pages.title: Stunt Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Stunt Simulator gives you cars and room to experiment with driving tricks. Build speed, take on jumps, and try to land flips or barrel rolls. The stunt scoring rewards your aerial maneuvers as you explore the driving area.

pages.title: 9 Ball Pool
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: 9 Ball Pool focuses on aiming shots around a pool table and pocketing the nine ball. Set up a line toward the target and control the strike, using the table's angles as you work to finish efficiently.

pages.title: Stickman Tennis
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Stickman Tennis brings stick-figure opponents into a table-tennis contest. Play through rallies and try to beat each rival, reacting to the ball's return as you work toward winning the current match and reaching another opponent.

pages.title: Become a mechanic
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Become a mechanic puts you in charge of a vehicle-repair garage. Attend to the cars that arrive and complete the requested work, keeping service moving as you try to repair more vehicles and satisfy the waiting customers.

pages.title: Girly House Cleaning
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Girly House Cleaning lets you tidy and restore three rooms. Put clothes into a basket, vacuum and wash windows in the bedroom, then tackle water, cobwebs and other problems elsewhere in the house. Complete the cleaning activities to refresh each space.

pages.title: Flappy Flying Fish
pages.creator: eric leung
pages.description: Flappy Flying Fish follows a fish traveling between the sea and the air. Guide it above the water while returning to the sea regularly to protect its health. Staying airborne too long or climbing too high drains health more quickly.

pages.title: Cut The Glow Candy
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Cut The Glow Candy fills the play area with luminous sweets to slice. Cut through the appearing candies and keep reacting to the next group, working to collect more successful cuts and finish with a higher score.

pages.title: Bomb Challenge
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Bomb Challenge tests the timing of your launches around rotating barriers. Watch the aiming arrow and send the bomb through an opening when the path is clear. Mistimed shots collide with the moving obstacles and cost a life.

pages.title: Spear Toss
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Spear Toss challenges you to throw a spear as far as possible. Tap to start moving, hold to choose the throwing angle, and release to launch. Compare the distances of your throws and try to improve your best toss.

pages.title: Katana Fruits
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Katana Fruits asks you to slice every fruit appearing on the screen without letting pieces drop. Swipe through the targets and keep the blade clear of bombs, timing the cuts as new groups enter the play area.

pages.title: Arrows
pages.creator: Novel Games Limited
pages.description: Arrows challenges you to exchange two groups of colored arrow tiles. Move the four purple pieces from their starting side and the four yellow pieces the opposite way, planning how the available space lets the sets pass one another.

pages.title: Ariana Grande World Tour
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Ariana Grande World Tour puts you in the role of Ariana's fashion adviser during her tour. Explore the clothing choices and assemble outfits for the performer, coordinating different looks as she prepares for appearances along the journey.

pages.title: Rugby Down Heroes
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Rugby Down Heroes turns a rugby run into a battle through opposing players. Guide your hero around the field, evade the opposition, and collect bonuses to charge a special attack. Complete challenges and work toward unlocking additional heroes.

pages.title: Paws to Beauty: Arctic Edition
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Paws to Beauty: Arctic Edition lets you care for animals from a cold-weather setting. Work through the grooming routine by washing, rinsing, drying, and brushing your chosen pet. Use each tool to finish its part of the makeover.

pages.title: Girls Dash
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Girls Dash is a grid puzzle in which girls bump one another out of the playing area. Swipe a character toward another to set off a collision. Plan the sequence of moves so that only one girl remains on the board.

pages.title: Pop Star Princess Dresses 2
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Pop Star Princess Dresses 2 combines makeup, hairstyling and outfit design for a performer. Choose colors and fashion pieces that suit her party appearance, putting together a complete stage-ready style through the different makeover activities.

pages.title: Ice Queen Twins Birth
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Ice Queen Twins Birth follows the Ice Queen getting ready for her twins' arrival. Gather the items needed for the hospital and help her stay comfortable while the ambulance comes. Continue with the game's baby-care activities after the birth.

pages.title: Princess Scooter Ride
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Scooter Ride lets you prepare two princesses for an outing on their scooters. Choose clothing and suitable equipment for the ride, coordinating an outfit for each friend as they get ready for their shared adventure.
